name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: The second recombination test. This component is field + popup + menu, and it declares no new style. The input is a field control (field.row + field-control marker); the trigger and clear buttons are Clickable.Button; the content is popup.content; items are menu.selectableItem; the item indicator is menu.itemIndicator; group labels are menu.label; separators are menu.separator. If this file contains a class that does not come from a family, the recombination claim is wrong. It does not. Supports single and multiple selection (with chips).
